episodes.synopsis: Kurapika, Gon, Killua and Leorio find out that the spiders are still alive and that the bodies were fake. The mafia has given up on chasing the Spiders, but Gon and Killua decide to continue to help Kurapika.
episodes.title: Spider x Corpses x Fake

episodes.synopsis: Kurapika explains his abilities to Gon, Killua and Leorio. Then they set out to find the Phantom Troupe. The Troupe decides to stay and find the chain-user after sensing the location of the nen-copied scarlet eyes.
episodes.title: Friends x Costumes x Hell's Ear

episodes.synopsis: A double chase ensues when the Spiders notice Gon and Kurapika following from behind while they chase after the nen-copy of the scarlet eyes. Three of the Spiders confront Gon and Kurapika who are hiding in the shadows.
episodes.title: Pursuit x Escape x Spiders on the Run

episodes.synopsis: Killua swaps with Kurapika just in time - he and Gon are captured by the Phantom Troupe. The Spiders kill Squala and take his memories of Kurapika. Meanwhile, Gon's group ends up at the hotel where Leorio and Senritsu have set up a plan.
episodes.title: Hostage x Insignificant Bugs x Communicated Emotions

episodes.synopsis: The plan is put into action: The Spider's Boss, Chrollo Lucilfer is captured by Kurapika. Gon and Killua however, are unable to escape.
episodes.title: Report x Darkness x Released Chain

episodes.synopsis: Negotiations between Kurapika's team and the Phantom Troupe are initiated to exchange Chrollo for Killua and Gon.
episodes.title: Dispute x Break-Up x Swinging Fist

episodes.synopsis: The conditions for the exchange are negotiated and Hisoka sees his chance to fullfil his prophecy.
episodes.title: Exchange x Revenge x Discipline Chain

episodes.synopsis: Since Chrollo's Nen ability was sealed, Hisoka looses interest in the battle with him and revealed that the tattoo of his spider status was fake. Pakunoda transfers her memories to six Phantom Troupe members and as a result dies for not obeying the chain's rules.
episodes.title: Thoughtfulness x Hopelessness x The Spider's Downfall
